tasks.title: Project Initialization and Infrastructure Setup
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository with the required technology stack including React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and the backend server.
tasks.details: Initialize a Vite-based React project with TypeScript. Configure Tailwind CSS for styling. Set up the backend structure using Node.js with Express (or Next.js API routes if preferred). Install necessary dependencies: `react-router-dom` for routing, `zustand` for state management, `axios` for HTTP requests, `react-hook-form` and `zod` for forms. Create the initial folder structure (`src/components`, `src/pages`, `src/services`, `server/`, etc.). Configure ESLint and Prettier for code quality.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify project builds without errors. Check if Tailwind classes are applied correctly. Ensure the development server starts for both frontend and backend.

tasks.title: Database Schema Design and ORM Setup
tasks.description: Design the database schema for Visitors, Memberships, and Animals and set up the ORM.
tasks.details: Choose SQLite for the MVP as per PRD. Install and configure Prisma (or Drizzle). Define the schema in `schema.prisma` including models for `User` (Admin/Staff), `Visitor` (name, email, phone, visitDate, etc.), `Membership` (type, startDate, expirationDate, link to Visitor), and `Animal` (name, species, care logs). Include relations like Membership-Visitor and Animal-FeedingLogs. Run migrations to create the database file.
tasks.testStrategy: Run database migrations successfully. Use Prisma Studio or a database viewer to inspect the created tables and verify relationships.

tasks.title: Shared UI Components and Layout Implementation
tasks.description: Create reusable UI components and the main application layout with navigation.
tasks.details: Develop a responsive shell layout with a sidebar navigation (collapsible on mobile) and a top header containing the global search bar placeholder. Implement atomic components using Tailwind: Buttons, Cards, Inputs, Tables, and Modals. Ensure accessibility (ARIA labels). Create a `Layout` component that wraps the pages. Set up React Router with routes for Dashboard, Visitors, Memberships, and Animals.
tasks.testStrategy: Visual inspection of the layout on Desktop and Mobile viewports. interactive testing of navigation links to ensure correct routing.

subtasks.title: Implement Atomic UI Components (Button, Input, Card)
subtasks.description: Create the foundational reusable components using Tailwind CSS to ensure UI consistency across the application.
subtasks.details: Develop `Button.tsx` (variants: primary, secondary, danger; sizes: sm, md, lg), `Input.tsx` (supports label, helper text, error state, and ref forwarding), and `Card.tsx` (container with standard padding, border, and shadow). Use `class-variance-authority` or `clsx` for managing Tailwind class logic.
subtasks.testStrategy: Render components in a temporary test page or Storybook. Verify click handlers execute and style variants apply correctly based on props.

subtasks.title: Implement Complex Interactive Components (Table, Modal)
subtasks.description: Develop reusable Table and Modal components for data display and user interactions like forms or confirmations.
subtasks.details: Create a `Table` component that accepts columns and data props for standardized rendering. Create a `Modal` component using React Portals that includes a backdrop, accessible title, body, footer, and handles closing via backdrop click or ESC key.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test Modal opening/closing logic and focus trapping. Verify Table renders data arrays correctly and handles empty states visually.

subtasks.title: Develop Responsive App Layout and Navigation
subtasks.description: Build the main application shell including Sidebar, Header, and a Layout wrapper to contain page content.
subtasks.details: Create `Layout.tsx` as the main wrapper. Implement `Sidebar` with navigation links that collapses into a hamburger menu on mobile viewports. Implement `Header` containing the global search bar placeholder. Ensure the layout handles scrolling content correctly.
subtasks.testStrategy: Resize window to mobile width (e.g., <768px) to verify Sidebar collapse mechanism. Verify Header stays fixed or flows as intended.

subtasks.title: Configure React Router and Placeholder Pages
subtasks.description: Set up the client-side routing architecture and create initial placeholder views for the application modules.
subtasks.details: Configure `react-router-dom`. Define routes for `/dashboard`, `/visitors`, `/memberships`, and `/animals`. Create simple placeholder components for these pages. Wrap the routes with the `Layout` component created in the previous step.
subtasks.testStrategy: Click through all navigation links in the Sidebar. Verify the URL updates correctly and the corresponding placeholder content loads in the main area.

subtasks.title: Finalize UI Accessibility and Responsive Polish
subtasks.description: Ensure all components and layouts meet accessibility standards and respond correctly to different device sizes.
subtasks.details: Audit components for ARIA attributes (e.g., `aria-expanded` on sidebar toggle, `role="dialog"` on modals). Ensure keyboard navigation works for the Sidebar and Modal. Verify consistent spacing and typography scales in `tailwind.config.js`.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use keyboard-only navigation (Tab/Enter/Esc) to traverse the menu and interact with a test modal. Run a basic accessibility check using a browser extension like WAVE.

tasks.title: Backend API Development for Visitors
tasks.description: Implement RESTful API endpoints for Visitor management.
tasks.details: Create Express routes for CRUD operations on Visitors: `GET /api/visitors`, `GET /api/visitors/:id`, `POST /api/visitors`, `PUT /api/visitors/:id`, `DELETE /api/visitors/:id`. Implement controller logic using the ORM to interact with the database. Add validation middleware using Zod to ensure data integrity (e.g., valid email format). Handle edge cases like duplicate visitors.
tasks.testStrategy: Use Postman or curl to test all endpoints. Verify successful creation, retrieval, updates, and deletion of visitor records. Test validation errors with invalid data.

tasks.title: Visitor Management Frontend Implementation
tasks.description: Build the frontend pages for listing, adding, and editing visitors.
tasks.details: Create `VisitorsList` page with a table displaying visitors, including pagination and filtering. Create `VisitorForm` component using `react-hook-form` and `zod` for validation. specific fields: name, email, phone, group size. Implement the 'Add Visitor' flow. Create `VisitorDetail` page to show history. Integrate with the backend API using Axios/Fetch.
tasks.testStrategy: User acceptance testing: Add a new visitor, verify they appear in the list. Edit visitor details and verify persistence. Check pagination logic.

tasks.title: Backend API Development for Memberships
tasks.description: Implement RESTful API endpoints for Membership management including auto-renewal logic.
tasks.details: Create endpoints: `GET /api/memberships`, `POST /api/memberships` (create new), `POST /api/memberships/renew` (renew). Implement logic to automatically calculate expiration dates (e.g., +1 year) upon creation or renewal. Implement filtering parameters for 'expiring soon'. Ensure memberships can be linked to existing Visitor IDs.
tasks.testStrategy: Test creation of memberships and verify expiration date calculation. Test the renewal endpoint to ensure it extends the correct date. Verify filtering returns correct subset of data.

tasks.title: Membership Management Frontend Implementation
tasks.description: Develop the interface for managing memberships, renewals, and expiration tracking.
tasks.details: Create `MembershipsList` page with tabs/filters for 'Active', 'Expiring Soon', and 'Expired'. Build a form to create new memberships, allowing selection of an existing visitor or creating a new one. Implement the 'Renew' button functionality on the list/detail view. Visual indicators (colors/badges) for status.
tasks.testStrategy: Create a membership and check if it appears in the Active list. Manually set a near-expiry date in DB and check if it appears in 'Expiring Soon'. Test the renew flow.

tasks.title: Animal Care Backend & Frontend
tasks.description: Implement full stack functionality for Animal records, including feeding and vet logs.
tasks.details: Backend: API for Animals (CRUD) and nested resources for `FeedingLog` and `VetVisit`. Frontend: `AnimalList` with filters (Species, Habitat). `AnimalDetail` page displaying info and two related lists: Feeding History and Vet Visits. Forms to 'Log Feeding' and 'Log Vet Visit'. Ensure forms validate dates (no future dates for logs unless backdating allowed with note).
tasks.testStrategy: Add an animal. Add several feeding logs. Verify they appear in chronological order on the detail page. Test search by species.

tasks.title: Global Search and Dashboard Aggregation
tasks.description: Implement the Dashboard summary view and Global Search functionality.
tasks.details: Create a `Dashboard` page fetching aggregated metrics: Today's visitor count, Active Members, Upcoming Events (mocked if events not fully impl), Animal Care alerts. Implement the Global Search bar in the header: Debounced input that calls a search endpoint (`/api/search?q=...`) which queries Visitors, Members, and Animals, returning grouped results. Navigate to detail pages on click.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify dashboard numbers match actual data in DB. Type a known name in global search and verify it finds the correct Visitor/Member/Animal.

tasks.title: Final Polish, Error Handling, and Deployment Prep
tasks.description: Refine UI/UX, implement comprehensive error handling, and prepare for MVP release.
tasks.details: Implement a global Error Boundary in React. Add toast notifications (using a library like `react-hot-toast` or `sonner`) for success/error actions (e.g., 'Visitor Added Successfully'). Audit for accessibility (tab order, contrast). Ensure responsive behavior on tablet sizes. Clean up code, remove console logs, and write basic documentation (README).
tasks.testStrategy: Trigger network errors (disconnect internet) and verify graceful degradation. Tab through the app to ensure keyboard navigability. Verify mobile/tablet layout responsiveness.
